places.name: Neo-Tokyo (fictional)
places.connection: The film is set in this sprawling, dystopian metropolis, built on the ruins of the original Tokyo after its destruction in a cataclysm.

places.name: Japan National Stadium
places.connection: The construction site for the 2020 Olympic Stadium is a pivotal location where Akira is stored and the film's climax occurs, famously 'predicting' the real-world event.

places.name: Shibuya
places.connection: The vibrant, chaotic, and neon-saturated aesthetic of Neo-Tokyo's cityscapes is heavily inspired by real districts like Shibuya and Shinjuku.

places.name: Neo-Tokyo
places.connection: The fictional setting of the film, built on the ruins of the old Tokyo after a cataclysmic explosion. It is a stand-in for the real Tokyo.
